run_fix_episode_placements: run the fix_episode_placements CLI tool to validate and correct object receptacle placements in a CollaborationDataset
run_correct_obj_rec_inits: run correct_obj_rec_inits to validate and fix clutter object initializations against active receptacles in a simulation episode
run_try_resnap: run try_resnap to re-snap an object onto a target receptacle by lifting and dropping it with collision checks
run_export_results_csv: run export_results_csv to write a nested validation results dictionary to a CSV file
run_fix_placement: run fix_placement to attempt automatic correction of invalid object placements by trying resnap and alternative receptacles
